News, Information, and Resources for the Public
------------------------------
[image: This Week's Updates]
------------------------------
Independence Day
🎆 USA at 250 🎆
[image: USA 250]
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Flacounty.gov%2F2026%2F06%2F18%2F250th-anniversary-of-the-united-states%2F%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/1/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/ps4Jl22BWZe10_1Cyaf58iF0cb1RaF4kZddilzrqHeU=452>


Los Angeles County celebrates the 250th Anniversary of the United States
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Flacounty.gov%2F2026%2F06%2F18%2F250th-anniversary-of-the-united-states%2F%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/2/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/ykdWxTau1e7m11WBICimhTE0jw3A6JR522FDJK9r_AQ=452>
.

In honor of the 250th Anniversary of the United States of America and the
Independence Day holiday, most County offices will be closed on Friday,
July 3, 2026, and will reopen on Monday, July 6, 2026.

------------------------------
Celebrate Responsibly
[image: Fireworks Displays]
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Ffire.lacounty.gov%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F06%2F2026-Public-Fireworks-Display-List-2.pdf%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/1/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/-NoT7P4H_m_wBfAep9EcVYIxHBSTali5Y13CmbucAxY=452>


🎉 The holiday weekend is almost here!

For your own safety and the safety of your community, please heed safety
tips
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Ffire.lacounty.gov%2Ffireworks-safety-and-july-4th-celebration-information%2F%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/1/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/25WL3zSWWp2QAXbhAkud7Fc_sDLYfy3XPKqBSv9nay8=452>
and applicable laws for your location. *All fireworks are prohibited in
unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.* Different cities have
different laws that apply within their boundaries.

🟢 Enjoy professional shows and events. The Los Angeles County Fire
Department has a list of fireworks shows here (*PDF
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Ffire.lacounty.gov%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F06%2F2026-Public-Fireworks-Display-List-2.pdf%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/2/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/qpNM2-PjQXINb-IQE8a_i30Ux_adbgw_YsJA2BaUglM=452>*
).

------------------------------
Tax Relief Webinar for Disaster Victims
Friday, July 10
[image: DCBA Tax Relief Webinar]
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fform.jotform.com%2F261655861493164%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/1/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/7zDrnwnv2QE0exGYdODiUnWJQ0c_nHy2-HDlqCpDboA=452>


*The Los Angeles County Department of Consumer & Business Affairs* is
hosting a webinar
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fform.jotform.com%2F261655861493164%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/2/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/A9NmQwPegauQ35874GXZQaA4kGXdKc9K4o_0YsMOhEE=452>
about tax relief for wildfire disaster victims.

📅 Friday, July 10, 2026
🕛 12 Noon to 1 p.m.
🟢 Register Here
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fform.jotform.com%2F261655861493164%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/3/0100019f1fa0cb6a-02582726-998a-470f-bd79-8790d5c75b99-000000/zsSWq5mo2THlYBkmFnH5KoMuXiH5vP_3-ZVWyRcgSmY=452>

Topics include:
🔵 Federal and State tax disaster rules
🔵 Casualty loss deductions
🔵 Tax free disaster relief
🔵 Relief programs for victims
🔵 Free consultations and services for low-income taxpayers
